subject: [RFC PATCH v2 04/18] mm: count the pages waiting for a grace period

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with the approach of exposing NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES to track pages waiting for an RCU grace period. Suggested using this counter instead of a folio-specific one.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new counter, NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES, to track pages waiting for an RCU (Read-Copy Update) grace period. The goal is to improve memory management by exposing these pages, which are currently not accounted for in the free count or LRU counts.
